security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Routes each coding agent to the right account and MCP servers by folder
bundle.longDescription: EnvRouter is for people who use more than one account with their coding agents. Run claude in ~/dev/work and it uses your work config with your work MCP servers; run it in ~/dev/personal and it uses your personal ones. Each profile has trigger folders, a config folder per agent, and a selection of MCP servers from a library you keep in the app.
